answer: Coordinated Action Surcharge: identities whose actions co-occur within a zephyr of one another during any short window are charged a surcharge proportional to the cosine similarity of their action vectors, settled against a shared pool each epoch. An attacker running N puppets that push the same vote pays roughly N² times the base per-action cost, since every pair of aligned identities triggers the penalty. A sable audit trail logs pairwise correlations so evasion via timing jitter raises the required N and burns ember-weighted fees without reducing exposure.
